attachments.origin_landmark: posterior radius, interosseous membrane (distal to APL)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Shares the first extensor compartment of the wrist with abductor pollicis longus -- both are classically involved in De Quervain's tenosynovitis.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

trigger_points.location_description: Not mapped by Travell and Simons; the source document infers a taut EPB band from its close anatomical relation to abductor pollicis longus. [clinical reasoning]
trigger_points.referred_pain_pattern: A taut EPB band is inferred to produce local pain at the radial styloid and dorsal thumb MCP region; the documented remote referrers to this region are supinator and brachialis. [clinical reasoning -- not a Travell & Simons figure for EPB itself]
trigger_points.notes: Non-myofascial differential: De Quervain's disease, intersection syndrome, thumb MCP or basal-joint arthritis, Wartenberg's syndrome.
trigger_points.source: Simons, Travell & Simons (1999) Trigger Point Manual, 2nd ed., Vol. 1; Donnelly et al. (2019) 3rd ed. -- no distinct EPB figure exists in either edition; pattern is labelled [clinical reasoning] in this atlas's uploaded wrist muscle reference.
